title: WARRANT evidence record
description: One evidence record under `.warrant/evidence/<change>/` (06a section 2). Written only by the CLI.

id.description: Evidence id `EVID-<ULID>`; counters are not allowed (ADR-0012).

claim.description: What this evidence asserts and which spec objects it is about.

targets.description: Stable ids the claim is about.

kind.description: Evidence kind from the catalogue declared by packs, for example `test-report`.

level.description: Verification level of the producer: L0, L1 or L2.

subject.description: Exactly what was observed: the code, spec revision and data the claim holds for.

commit.description: Commit the evidence was produced against.

base_commit.description: Base commit a diff-scoped claim was measured against (ADR-0016); absent when the claim is not relative to a base.

spec_revision.description: Spec revision the claim refers to, for example `openspec/specs/ingestion@abc1234`.

spec_tree.description: Hash of the spec tree of the Change (`proposal.md`, `specs/**`) the claim holds for (ADR-0036 section 3): a record with it is judged by the spec tree at the evaluated commit instead of by `commit` and `base_commit`.

tree.description: Id of the git tree object of the result of the merge the record was made on, 40 or 64 lowercase hex characters (ADR-0037 section 2): written only by `warrant ci`; a record with it is judged by `commit` and the tree of the merge of the evaluated commit instead of by `base_commit`.

dataset_snapshot.description: Data snapshot the claim holds for, or null when no data is involved.

not.description: `spec_tree` and `tree` are never carried together: the pre-filter judges them by different rules (REQ-KRN-012).

produced_by.description: Who or what produced this evidence.

type.description: Producer class: a deterministic check, an LLM skill or a human.

id.description: Id of the check, skill or person.

run.description: Run id `RUN-<ULID>` during which the evidence was produced.

attestation.description: Who vouches for the provenance of this record (06a section 3).

ref.description: Reference backing the attestation, for example a CI run URL.

context_hash.description: Hash of the context the producer saw (06a section 6).

effective_policy_hash.description: Hash of the effective policy in force when the evidence was produced.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the record was written.

artifacts.description: Raw artefacts backing the claim, referenced by uri and hash.

limitations.description: What this evidence does not prove: scope, sampling, environment.

metrics.description: Results of the producer as named values. The kernel only requires an object: its shape is declared by the pack for the evidence kind (`metrics_schema` in `provides.evidence_kinds`) and checked by `warrant validate` as a second step (REQ-KRN-001, ADR-0016).
